title: Anime
heading: Anime & Animation
intro: Anime series, films, and animated shorts that I have enjoyed, followed, or am currently watching.

series.title: Steins;Gate
series.review: A masterpiece of time-travel fiction. The character dynamics in the Future Gadget Lab, the build-up of tension, and Okabe's relentless struggle make it unforgettable.

series.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
series.review: A profound, quiet, and emotionally resonant reflection on time, mortality, and companionship. Stunning animation and direction by Madhouse.

series.title: Your Name (Kimi no Na wa)
series.review: Makoto Shinkai at his absolute finest. The visual fidelity, emotional pacing, and RADWIMPS soundtrack create an unforgettable cinematic journey.

series.title: Attack on Titan (Shingeki no Kyojin)
series.review: Incredible world-building, high-stakes plot twists, and legendary sound design by Hiroyuki Sawano. A modern classic from start to finish.

series.title: Honkai & Genshin Animated Shorts
series.review: Masterclass short animations including 'The Divine Move', 'Song Burning in the Embers', 'Because of You', and 'The Final Lesson'. Emotionally charged with top-tier cinematography.

series.title: Jujutsu Kaisen
series.review: Superb choreography and animation quality, especially across the Shibuya Incident arc. Great pacing and soundtrack.

series.title: Solo Leveling
series.review: Hype-filled adaptation with great kinetic fight sequences and Hiroyuki Sawano's signature orchestral beats.
